description: Origin airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Forms the route key together with dest; only the three New York City airports (EWR, JFK, LGA)

description: Destination airport code for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Used as part of the route-level grouping key
notes_or_concerns: Includes one unusual route, EWR to LGA, with a single cancelled flight

description: Number of flights observed for the route
transformation_or_derivation: Count of flight records grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Includes cancelled flights; ranges from 1 to 11,262; 10 routes have fewer than 10 flights, so their averages are unstable

description: Average departure delay in minutes for each route
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of dep_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA because its only flight was cancelled; potential data leakage because departure delays are not known before the flights occur

description: Average arrival delay for flights on the route, in minutes (target)
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Averages only flights with a recorded arrival delay; missing for EWR to LGA (its only flight was cancelled); negative means early on average

description: Maximum arrival delay in minutes for each route
transformation_or_derivation: Maximum of arr_delay grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA; four single-flight routes have negative maximum delays. Potential data leakage because this value is unknown before the flights occur

description: Average flight distance in miles for each route
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of distance grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: No missing or nonpositive values identified

description: Average time spent in the air in minutes for each route
transformation_or_derivation: Mean of air_time grouped by origin and destination
notes_or_concerns: Missing for EWR to LGA because its only flight was cancelled
